serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: BetterUp for Government (BUFG) is a Workforce Performance and Optimization platform designed specifically to help government organizations achieve their mission-critical objectives. BUFG delivers performance-driven behavioral and mindset development aligned to each agency’s unique goals. Through the Partner Analytics Dashboard (PAD), BUFG equips government leaders with near real-time insights into emerging behavioral trends across their workforce, while fully safeguarding the privacy of individual program participants.
